summary.cause: fam_a prompt-v1.0 wrote quantity.period as null in 11 of 60 present quantities; 0 of 83 under prompt-v1.1; fam_b wrote no null period. Every malformed_value slot is one of those 11.
summary.guide_gaps_ruled_by: DEC:NEWS-IMPACT-GUIDE-V12-T1-AMOUNT-RULES (annotation guide-v1.2 sections 5.1 and 5.4); the v1 labels are not relabeled
summary.rescoring: none; summary.json stands (DEC:NEWS-IMPACT-W2-BENCHMARK-SCORING); the counterfactual is diagnostic only

verdicts.why: Revenue guidance is written as a centre plus or minus a tolerance. fam_a wrote a range, fam_b a point with bound approximately. The guide has no rule for plus-minus notation; Gate 4 (a guidance range is correct only if both bounds match) leans to the range.
A notes offering; both families took the offering principal as the new money. Only fam_a's period shape (null) made the slot malformed.
Both families took the same stated quantity and it is the right one. The case is a notes offering routed to the strategic/product template, which is a routing question, not a labeling error.

The filing amends existing term loans to conform their terms to a newly closed credit agreement; no new money is raised. fam_a slotted an existing facility size as new money; fam_b's not_stated absence is right.
fam_a slotted borrowing capacity as an authorization remainder. remaining_authorization is authorization left after a capital action, and the filing states none; fam_b's absence is right.

A preferred-stock reopening. fam_b took the aggregate liquidation amount in USD, the preferred analogue of a notes principal, as the new money. fam_a wrote a share count, which is the wrong unit for a money slot. Medium: a liquidation amount is not proceeds.

Values agree and are right. The source raises a program to a new maximum outstanding: fam_a's bound up_to fits, fam_b's bound exact does not, and the grader does not score bound. The case is a commercial paper program routed to the demand/guidance/contract template, a routing oddity.
An at-the-market program; both families took the program size with bound up_to.

A quarterly earnings release routed to the strategic/product template. fam_a took a buyback figure, fam_b a profit figure; neither is a strategic or product-event quantity, and the guide's 'any quantity the source attaches to the event' does not decide which quantity attaches to an earnings release.
A closed notes offering; both families took the principal as the executed amount.
Same closed notes offering; both took the principal as the new money.
